subject.title: [Feature]: Harden Control UI Lit lifecycle boundaries

question: Should Control UI lifecycle hardening land as one coordinated modernization slice, or be split into smaller PRs by lifecycle seam?
rationale: The source evidence supports the request, but the protected label and broad UI surface require maintainer intent on scope and sequencing before repair automation should act.

options.title: Split by lifecycle seam
options.body: Create separate PRs for shared host/i18n behavior, external-source subscriptions, router pending/not-found state, and chat post-render/persistence teardown.

options.title: Land one coordinated slice
options.body: Allow one broader refactor only if the owner wants a single review and it includes broad Control UI regression and browser proof.

options.title: Narrow to proven bugs
options.body: Defer shared abstractions and fix only source-proven lifecycle races as individual bugs with dedicated tests.

recommendation.title: Split by lifecycle seam
recommendation.body: Create separate PRs for shared host/i18n behavior, external-source subscriptions, router pending/not-found state, and chat post-render/persistence teardown.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main blame makes `vincentkoc` the strongest available routing candidate for the implicated lifecycle files in this checkout.
